articles.title: Three arrested, 170 kg of cocaine seized in ‘large-scale’ trafficking operation across Golden Horsehoe
articles.summary: Three men are facing drug charges in what the RCMP say was part of a large-scale and sophisticated cocaine trafficking operation across the Golden Horseshoe. Investigators executed a search warrant on July 8 at an Etobicoke condominium which police allege was being used to store and prepare cocaine for distribution. More than 170 kg of […]

articles.title: Brampton man, 19, charged in alleged sexual assault at Vaughan amusement park
articles.summary: York Regional Police (YRP) say a 19-year-old man has been charged with sexual assault following an alleged incident at an amusement park in Vaughan. articles.title: Third week wraps up in New York trial of man accused of killing daughter
articles.summary: ELIZABETHTOWN — Prosecutors are expected to wrap up their case today in the trial of a man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter last summer during a trip to New York.

articles.title: 'We want it back for another 30 years': Taste of the Danforth returns after 2-year hiatus
articles.summary: The Taste of the Danforth festival has been on hiatus since 2023 after financial shortfalls, but funding from the province and the city helped bring it back, with the federal government announcing additional support just days before it kicks off.

articles.title: Man in life-threatening condition after hit-and-run in Oshawa
articles.summary: A man is in life-threatening condition after a hit-and-run in north Oshawa on Thursday afternoon, Durham police say.

articles.title: 2 people, including 15-year-old, facing multiple charges after gunshot fired at U.S. consulate in Toronto
articles.summary: Two people have been arrested and are now facing a host of charges after a gunshot hit the U.S. consulate in downtown Toronto last week, police say.

articles.title: Police watchdog investigating fatal officer-involved crash, shooting in Mississauga
articles.summary: Ontario's police watchdog is investigating the death of a 19-year-old man after an officer-involved crash and shooting in Mississauga early Thursday morning.
